_comment: Server-side mods that are NOT part of the .mrpack. Kept separate because mods.lock.json is regenerated from the pack and would drop anything added to it by hand. Same download+sha512 verification as the pack mods.

mods.title: BlueMap
mods.why: 3D web map served at map.mtrdrgzcid.com. client_side:unsupported, server_side:required.

mods.title: AntiXray
mods.why: Real ore obfuscation: the server sends fake blocks so xray sees nothing. server_side:required, client_side:unsupported, so players change nothing.
